Name: Hair Tints (CP)
Author: MellyJustMelly
Description:
I kept going with the hair recolour mods and now did one of tinted hair that is also lighter. You have multiple colours to choose from. Obviously some colours work better for certain hair colours, but you can pick and choose which works the best.
This is only my second ever uploaded mod and again, I hope there is no issue. My testing phases went well.
This mod applies to ONLY the vanilla hairstyles as of now! Any modded hair will not have this mod applied!

Idk why, I just enjoyed the option of also having a slight tinted feel to the hair depending on the kind of hair colour you want.
I hope they work well and that you enjoy them <3 <3


If you wish to have lighter hair but no coloured tint, then there are both the slight Option as well as my general [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37809]Hair Colour[/url]﻿ mod to maybe have what you're looking for!

Manifest.Description: Tint your hair with nice colours!
